categories.main_business_segments: Hangzhou Coco Healthcare Products Co., Ltd. primarily operates in the disposable hygiene products industry, focusing on the design, research, production, and sales of adult incontinence products, baby care products, and pet hygiene products. The company emphasizes its own brands and ODM services, with a strong presence in adult incontinence care and elderly care services.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs advanced manufacturing technologies including automated and intelligent production lines, ERP and MES systems for production and material management, and has developed proprietary absorbent core technologies such as composite absorbent cores replacing traditional fluff pulp. It also invests in R&D for biodegradable materials and high-performance SAP applications, supported by a provincial enterprise research institute and numerous patents.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include retail chains, distributors, healthcare institutions, elderly care facilities, and end consumers across various channels such as online e-commerce platforms (Tmall, JD.com, Pinduoduo), offline distributors, key accounts like Walmart and RT-Mart, and long-term care insurance programs. The company serves markets domestically in China and is expanding into international markets including the US and Europe.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with significant domestic sales and production facilities in Zhejiang Province. It also has growing overseas sales, particularly through cross-border e-commerce channels targeting markets such as the United States and the United Kingdom. Subsidiaries and joint ventures are located mainly in Zhejiang and Shanghai, with some upstream material production in Guangxi.
categories.supply_chain_position: Coco Healthcare operates across the midstream and downstream segments of the supply chain, including product design, raw material procurement, manufacturing, and sales. It has extended upstream by investing in core raw material production such as fluff pulp manufacturing to control costs and quality, thus integrating vertically to some extent.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes innovation in product performance, especially in adult incontinence care, focusing on absorbent core technology, antibacterial and deodorizing features, and biodegradable materials. It aims to expand product lines to cover diverse consumer needs and market segments, enhance intelligent manufacturing capabilities, and develop a comprehensive user-centered ecosystem integrating products and services. Cross-border expansion and deepening upstream raw material integration are also strategic R&D focuses.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through product sales of self-owned brands and ODM manufacturing services. Sales channels include direct sales to distributors, key accounts, institutions, and online platforms. The company also benefits from government subsidies and investment income, but the core revenue is from physical product sales.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Coco Healthcare is a leading domestic brand in the adult incontinence product market in China, recognized as a pioneer and market leader with strong brand influence and innovation capabilities. It competes with numerous domestic and international hygiene product manufacturers, maintaining a top position in e-commerce sales and industry rankings. The company is also recognized as a national patent industrialization model and a provincial manufacturing champion.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenue of approximately RMB 1.08 billion, with a slight year-on-year decrease of 0.27%, but net profit attributable to shareholders increased by 54.44% to about RMB 31.17 million. The company has total assets of around RMB 2.09 billion and equity of RMB 1.33 billion, showing steady growth and improved profitability despite challenging market conditions.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Coco Healthcare emphasizes high-quality, innovative, and user-centric disposable hygiene products with advanced absorbent technology, superior comfort, and specialized designs for different consumer segments including elderly and light incontinence users. Its vertically integrated supply chain, strong R&D capabilities, and comprehensive sales channels provide competitive advantages. The company also focuses on brand reputation, product differentiation through technology, and expanding into emerging markets such as silver economy and cross-border e-commerce.
